description: Tools a rendered role never needs, removed through disallowedTools so their schemas stay out of its context, and the CLAUDE.md chain left out through omitClaudeMd: a role takes its rules from the constitution and the spawn prompt. mcp__<server> removes every tool of that server and mcp__* every MCP tool; built-in tools take exact names. A browser role keeps the preview browser and the other MCP servers it may use. Only a role that starts agents keeps Agent.
